value.deck: Software developers using GitHub Copilot now have a new AI helper called Grok 4.6 to choose from.
shortVersion: Imagine having a digital toolbox where you can pick different helpers for different tasks. A popular tool for software coders, called GitHub Copilot, just added a new AI assistant named Grok 4.6.
This new option was built by a company called xAI. It joins existing AI helpers from Google and Anthropic inside the same coding app.
Giving people more choices lets them pick the right tool for each project. More variety helps coders work better and finish software faster.
value.plainLanguage: People who write computer code now have a new AI helper named Grok 4.6 available in their tools.

keyTerms.meaning: An AI-powered tool that helps people write computer code.
A specific artificial intelligence helper created by the company xAI.
A computer system trained to understand instructions and generate useful answers.

value.whyItMatters: More choices mean developers can select the absolute best helper for each job, which helps software get built more smoothly.
watchNext: Watch to see how developers choose between the different available AI helpers.
